title: viz1090
summary: Live ADS-B aircraft from an RTL-SDR dongle on a world map, full screen.
description: The viz1090 display by Nathan Matsuda with its own readsb decoder. An intro screen checks for the SDR and an optional USB GPS and sets your position. Needs an RTL-SDR dongle with a 1090 MHz antenna. Runs on the deck boards and x86 PCs, upright in PDA mode. Map data: Natural Earth, OurAirports. viz1090: BSD; readsb: GPL-3, source https://github.com/wiedehopf/readsb.
depends: libsdl2-2.0-0, libsdl2-ttf-2.0-0, libsdl2-gfx-1.0-0, librtlsdr0, libusb-1.0-0, libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libncurses6, libzstd1, zlib1g, python3
